paragraphs.text: Our Heavenly Father, we come to Thee, at this hour, early in the morning, as the disciples came to the tomb to find it empty, the great Conqueror had rose from the dead.

paragraphs.text: We gather here this morning for the purpose of worshipping Him, singing out the glad tidings around the world today, that Jesus arose from the dead. We thank Thee for His great life and for His great approval that You put upon Him that He was the Son of God. As He said in the days while He was alive, “Destroy this temple, and I’ll raise it up again in three days.” We thank Thee for this, that You gave Him power to fulfill what He said He would do.
